correctness.rationale: For every fixed m,n,s and both Gaussian fields, the spectral block triangularity and residualized coefficient follow algebraically. Conditional on spectator sketches, the residualized first sketch has ν=s-m+1 isotropic dimensions, while the sketched orthogonal residual is independent. The exact real χ² and complex gamma ratios give the beta-incomplete and closed rational tails. Gamma integrals prove finite p-moments exactly below ν (real) or 2ν (complex) and infinite values at and above. Explicit second-moment constants and exact row thresholds follow; the packaged matrix and tail verifiers corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact field-sensitive phase transition from infinite to finite mean-square Ritz error is a motivated and nontrivial sketch-design boundary, not an arbitrary invariant or reparameterization. The theorem supplies all moment cutoffs and tail constants for the *same* named algorithmic matrix, allowing reliable interpretation of statistical error criteria and contrasting real and complex sketch row counts. It does not claim generic eigenpair selection or computational-speed improvements.
